description: Source code for the AudioPeakingFilter class, implementing a digital audio filter with configuration, reset, and coefficient calculation methods, including filter parameter adjustments and range calculations.

classes.name: AudioPeakingFilter
classes.description: A class implementing a peaking filter for audio processing, with methods for configuration, parameter setting, and coefficient computation.

methods.name: configure
methods.description: Configures the filter with the number of channels and sample rate.

methods.name: reset
methods.description: Resets filter parameters to default values.

methods.name: setFrequency
methods.description: Sets the center frequency of the filter in millihertz.

methods.name: setGain
methods.description: Sets the gain of the filter in millibels.

methods.name: setBandwidth
methods.description: Sets the bandwidth of the filter in cents.

methods.name: commit
methods.description: Calculates and applies filter coefficients based on current parameters.

methods.name: getBandRange
methods.description: Calculates the low and high frequency range of the filter band.
